title: Chapter 215
text:
In the era of virtual online games, interactive experiences were very important. Players all thought that Galaxy had done a very good job in this aspect. Communication with NPCs was very free, and players could write messages and emails as they wished. Players could use this method to communicate with NPCs remotely.

In the current era, the popular games all had certain elements of reality. They had the function of virtual social networking. The old game Tyrannical was very good at this aspect. Even if it was in standalone mode, it could still write text messages at will.

Speaking of which, there was an interesting story. Ever since the advent of gaming cabin technology, Stonestone followed the trend of the times and ported "Rampaging Tyrant" to the gaming cabin. At that time, due to the authenticity of the virtual gaming technology and the rough gameplay of "Rampaging Tyrant", it even caused a moral debate. The legendary "NPC Protection Association" was really established. It was a pain in the ass, and it was very strange.

[The End of the Life of the Living] Completed.

Of the five requirements of the hidden main mission, one of them turned green, indicating that it had been completed.

You have received [Suly-485 File]. From the file, you have learned about the past.

"This mission even has a voice-over. What a joke." Han Xiao was surprised.

The files recorded a long-ago action plan. Many details are missing. Before the Old Era War, a country that had already perished sent a field team to a small town in the Andrea Continent to carry out a secret mission. The process is unknown, but the result was that all the residents of the town were killed.

"That's it?" Han Xiao scratched his head. This description was a quest clue, but it was too confusing. After thinking about it, he forwarded the content to Hannes. That old man had more clues, so he might be able to find something else.

All Han Xiao wanted was to complete the mission.

…

Hao Tian stood beside the mission character named 'Old Devon' and stared at his phone, waiting for Black Phantom's reply.

This mission was very tedious. Old Devon had kept the file, and the first thing to do was to gain Old Devon's trust and complete many errands. The difficult part was that Old Devon was a patient with a mental disorder. He had persecutory delusions, amnesia, split personality, irritable temper, nonsense, and more than a dozen other mental disorders. He was very prone to over-anxiety. When he saw a trash can on the street, he would think that it was a bomb. When he saw a passerby, he would think that the passersby were his enemies.

Old Devon had once participated in this plan. According to him, after completing the mission, he was hunted down by the country to silence him. He had been hiding from place to place, living in a state of constant anxiety all year round. He had become paranoid and suffered from various mental illnesses.

"Do you know why wars broke out in the old era?"

While chatting, Old Devon would often look around carefully. After confirming that no one was around, he said nervously, "It's because of me that they are all hunting me down. Every country wants to find me, so they started fighting. There are enemies everywhere. Even now, they haven't given up. Do you see those surveillance cameras in the city? They were all set up to find me."

Of course, Hao Tian did not understand a single word that was said. At the same time, he did not care about the storyline. He just focused on completing the mission. With his high efficiency and strong kidney power, he finally completed the mission.

Han Xiao's confirmation came from his phone. Hao Tian received the notification that the mission was completed, and he was relieved.

"You are the first person to complete the mission. I think you have a lot of potential. Are you interested in helping me?"

"Sure," Hao Tian replied simply.

"You go to the Raylan border and wait there. Coordinates R 1565.842. I will bring you along when I leave the Northern Continent."

"Okay."

Thinking about the various benefits of Black Phantom's hidden storyline that were circulating on the forums, even Hao Tian, who had a calmer personality, felt a little excited.

…

After visiting all the novice villages in the Northern Continent, Han Xiao's trip to the novice villages finally came to an end. Before leaving the Northern Continent, Han Xiao went to an ice field where high-level Snow Bears were active. He spent a few hours and used the Ghost sniper rifle to farm the talent [Lethal Shot].

[Lethal Shot: The first shot attack to the target has a 2-5% chance of causing True Damage. Will not be effective for the same target for five minutes.]

By changing the target, he could continuously try to trigger the effect of the talent. The effect was more practical. Although it was not as good as Bennett's [Legendary Battle Technique] Molding Ability, it was still a rare attack-type talent.

After counting, he had a total of twelve talents. This number was very outstanding in Version 1.0. If it was a LV 55 player, it would be more than half of Han Xiao's talents.

Han Xiao also tried the newly acquired talent [Call of the Wild]. The LV 50 + Snow Bears were not affected at all. They were as fierce as they could be.

He changed to a lower level target and found that a bear cub was very close to him. It was white, chubby, and furry. Its height was only up to his waist, and it hugged his leg and shook it like a spoiled child.

This talent is still a bit useful. The bear cub is only LV 20. Call of the Wild should have some hidden elements. Other than being affected by Charm, the level difference between me and the beast is also the reason. Hmm, it should also have something to do with the beast's habits.

Han Xiao muttered to himself. Suddenly, he saw this furry ball hugging his leg and trying to climb up, treating him like a tree. Han Technician squinted and kicked the bear cub away.

The white and chubby bear cub rolled a few times before hugging him again. It was very clingy and could not be chased away.

His furry buttocks shook, and his appearance was stupid. His pair of small black eyes were simple and honest.

"Tsk, so cute." Han Xiao was touched by the cuteness. He lifted the bear's butt and looked at it. "Oh, it's a female."

The man and the bear stared at each other for a long time. Han Xiao stretched out his arm, and the bear cub moved its butt with difficulty and climbed onto Han Xiao's shoulder to play on the swing.

"You must have koala blood. I didn't expect you to be a mixed-blood." Han Xiao was amazed. He twisted his neck, and the bear cub also swayed. It felt like he had an extra backpack.

"Let's take it back and raise it as a pet," Han Xiao said to himself.

Raising pets was the fun of life. With one more pet, Han Xiao suddenly felt a lot more relaxed. No wonder people in big cities liked to raise animals. It was simply a stress reliever. When they were unhappy, they could bully their pets and regain their sense of superiority as an intelligent species.

This was a claw ice bear cub. It was only a few months old. Han Xiao was too lazy to name it. He just called it Bear Cub.

With Bear Cub, he took a plane to the border of Raylan to pick up Hao Tian and immediately set off back to Southern Continent.

On the plane, Hao Tian was very quiet. He did not ask where they were going, nor did he take the initiative to interact with them. Han Xiao saw that he had nothing to do, so he gave him the task of taking care of Bear Cub. Hao Tian's expression became very interesting on the spot. He simply showed all the chaos in his heart on his face.

Because every detail in Galaxy was very real, especially the appearance and smell of feces and urine …

It only took half a day to fly from Northern Continent to Southern Continent. Han Xiao received a call from Hannes on the way, saying that Old Devon's file had added to their clues. This was a key clue, and Han Xiao knew that it would affect the hidden main plot of the next round.

The gains in the Northern Continent were no less than those in the Western Continent. His experience and assets had increased greatly, almost doubled. Every time Han Xiao saw the accumulated experience on the panel and the total assets in his Dark Net account, he felt full of happiness. It was like a washing machine turning over mountains and seas in his heart.

…

The plane landed in Southern Continent. Antonio had been waiting for a long time. As soon as he got off the plane, Han Xiao saw his rough face.

"My friend, welcome back alive." Antonio laughed and gave Han Xiao a bear hug. The strong smell on his body almost made Han Xiao bleed.

"I'll die if you hug me for a while more." Han Xiao frowned and rubbed his nose. The smell did not go away for a long time and went straight into his skull.

"You've only been out for less than a month, and look at what you've done!" Antonio was amazed. He still remembered that Han Xiao said that he would not be reckless. It seemed that compared to him, Han Xiao's standard of not being reckless was the difference between a mountain and a basin.

During this time, Black Phantom's deeds were spread out like a deep water bomb. Many forces had no choice but to retract part of their attention from the war and focus on Black Phantom. If there were no accidents, Black Phantom had become one of the top threats in most forces' files.

Black Phantom had officially reached the top of the Dark Net's assassin list, pushing all the other assassins down.

After chatting for a while, Antonio saw Bear Cub. His eyes lit up, and he ran over to rub it. From the appearance, Han Xiao was not surprised that Antonio liked furry things. These two balls of fur were probably close relatives.

Walking aside, Han Xiao dialed Bennett's number.

"I'm back."

Bennett let out a sigh of relief. With a bit of bitterness, he said, "I've been waiting for you for a long time."

Han Xiao went straight to the point. "The 'Sanctuary Plan' you mentioned last time, what do you need me to help with?"

Bennett was very touched. Han Xiao's first thought when he came back was to ask for help. What was this called? This was really a kind-hearted and timely help!

Nowadays, the moral of the world was deteriorating day by day. People who cared so much about relationships were almost extinct.

This was a friend worth making!

Bennett decided to let Black Phantom be one of the main executors of the plan and reveal the details, so he said, "Let's talk when we meet. I have a very important mission for you."

Hearing that, Han Xiao knew that there was hope. He was secretly excited. He was very familiar with the main storyline of the [Sanctuary Plan] and knew how great the benefits of being a core participant were.

Recently, the undercurrents of the Six Nations were surging. The preparation for the expedition war was about to be completed, and it was estimated that the expedition would be officially launched within this month. The enemy, the Germinal Organization, was finally going to face the catastrophe that Han Xiao had single-handedly created. The flames of war were about to spread to Blue Star. Everywhere in the world, wanderers, warlords, financial groups, secret organizations, and so on were very nervous.

Starting the main storyline of the [Sanctuary Plan] at this juncture completely messed up the order of the storyline, but the benefits were obvious. Under the threat of war, Bennett would invest resources to carry out the plan regardless of the cost.
